class.name: JarBodyOrbit
class.brief_description: Carries its children on a circular orbit around the parent body.
class.description: Put it under a [JarCelestialBody] and the moon (another [JarCelestialBody]) under it. Its position is a function of [JarVoxelUniverse] time, so it never drifts. It is top level: the parent's spin does not turn the orbit. In the editor it shows the position at time 0. While a body on it is the anchor (see [JarVoxelUniverse]), the orbit node itself stays where it is and its bodies are placed directly.
